quickstats_finney.csv.source: USDA NASS Quick Stats bulk crops file
quickstats_finney.csv.geography: Kansas state ANSI 20, Finney County ANSI 055. The configured point (37.94, -100.67) falls inside Finney on the Census county map.
quickstats_finney.csv.extract: COUNTY / SURVEY / TOTAL domain / ANNUAL / YEAR, 1990–2024 inclusive. Four exact data-item labels in config/yield_backtest.json. Kept all source columns. Removed NUL padding.

icrisat_warangal.csv.source: ICRISAT district-level kharif rice data published in the Maiti et al. (2024) study archive
icrisat_warangal.csv.extract: Warangal, Telangana, Dist.Code=60, Sh_Dist_code=2021, FID_1=19, 1990–2017. Kept the first twelve source columns, including published yield, and omitted study climate columns.
icrisat_warangal.csv.geography: Point-in-polygon check at 79.445 E, 17.845 N against WGS84 companion shapefile India_DI_sh_1993_F returned one polygon, Warangal (FID_1=19, IPUM1993=002021). Historical geography is distinct from current Warangal and Hanumakonda. District yield reaggregation method is unverified.
icrisat_warangal.csv.direct_portal_status: Connection timed out. The study archive and companion map were reachable.
